objective: Independent new-test paired mean L1 gain at least3% versus strongest initial self-trained model, at least3 training seeds, execution/instruction safeguards, NoEdit reporting and full delivery.

model.selection_rule: Minimum full200 validation L1 among the three predeclared same-recipe seeds; never replace from final test results.

limits: No stable superiority over NoEdit demonstrated.
L1 improvement is relative to old self-trained models; no universal aesthetic/local-edit claim.
AI-assisted anonymous review, not a human user study.
Base weight shards remain external under frozen revision and SHA audit.

archive.verification: Entire raw tar SHA plus exact member set, member sizes and every member SHA verified locally; no file extraction or unpickling required.

limitations: AI-assisted anonymous viewing of full-frame1800px9-panel sheets, not independent human review or a formal double-blind user study.
Model identities hidden per case until all210 notes frozen; reviewer knew aggregate campaign results and method hypotheses.
Only10/30 cases have specific requests; generic/empty requests never count as directional passes.
Fine sharpening details cannot be established at sheet scale; uncertainty and partial ratings retained.
Uniform preselected30 source groups; no case substitution, no new test-driven model selection.

external_dependencies.note: Current-state base files were rehashed during completion audit; venv binaries and base shards external, exact versions/configs included.

resource_account.scope: Telemetry-covered occupancy, excludes sample gaps and unmonitored smoke/replay; not a complete billing total.

negative_findings: Original SFT and GRPO did not improve earlier independent test.
Composite winning recipe has not isolated causal contributions of coverage, JSON supervision, calibration and averaging.
snapshot_policy: Archive is immutable and excludes this external receipt and subsequently generated completion audit. Final verification, audit, delivered-adapter receipt and current reading docs are sidecars; numeric-stage historical pending strings are not rewritten.
